limitations: Public EvidenceCore references are visible and must not be used for headline leaderboard claims.
Only EvidenceCore is currently an executable public scientific pack; the v0.2 registry and 39 task specifications are an implementation roadmap.
Thermodynamics, DFT, MLIP/MD, mesoscale, continuum and multiscale suites require sanitized replay assets or authorized live compute before capability claims.
Laboratory robotics and physical closed-loop suites require certified digital twins or frozen physical hardware protocols.
The current scientific domain begins with titanium alloys and titanium-matrix composites, not a complete materials-science census.
The synthetic execution task validates the scorer contract and is reported separately from real released tasks.
scope_statement: EvidenceCore is the currently executable public pack inside a twelve-suite full-stack materials-research benchmark architecture.
